agent_evaluations.detailed_feedback: This OSCE set FAILS radiology interpretation evaluation standards due to fundamental issues: (1) ZERO actual radiological interpretation content - all expected answers are generic templates ('findings consistent with [condition]') with no systematic CXR/CT/ECG interpretation using ABCDE/7-step/ABC frameworks; (2) Images appear to be placeholders with no actual radiological findings described; (3) No systematic approach demonstrated or required in tasks; (4) Missing critical radiology skills assessment (image quality, red flags, urgent communication). This content is NOT suitable for AMC Clinical Examination radiology stations without complete rewrite. Current state: 4.5/10 (FAIL). Required for PASS (≥7.0): Replace all expected answers with actual systematic radiological interpretations, provide real image descriptions with specific findings, add image quality assessment tasks, include critical findings identification, use radiology-specific references. Estimated rework required: 40+ hours to create authentic radiology OSCE content for all 50 cases.

agent_evaluations.reviewer_notes: This OSCE (RESP-OSCE-026: PE Risk Stratification) contains NO medication content to evaluate from a medication management perspective. The scenario, tasks, and expected answers focus solely on investigation interpretation (CTPA, troponin) without addressing anticoagulation - the PRIMARY pharmacological intervention for PE. This represents a critical gap in educational content. PE management is fundamentally a medication management challenge requiring: (1) Immediate anticoagulation selection (warfarin vs DOAC), (2) Renal dosing adjustments (common in elderly PE patients), (3) Drug interactions (many PE patients on amiodarone for AF), (4) PBS compliance (DOACs require authority), (5) Duration decisions (provoked vs unprovoked). A 10-minute OSCE on PE Risk Stratification that omits anticoagulation prescribing fails to assess a core clinical competency. Recommendation: Either (a) rename OSCE to 'PE Diagnosis and Investigation Interpretation' to reflect actual content, or (b) expand Task 3 to require detailed anticoagulation management plan with Australian drug names, PBS codes, and safety monitoring. Current score reflects absence of evaluable medication content, not poor medication management (which cannot be assessed when no medications are prescribed).
